intro: I work with founders, small teams, and studios on digital products and websites that need to feel clear, considered, and genuinely usable.

items.title: UX & product design
items.short: Turn a fuzzy product idea into a clear, testable interface.
items.description: Discovery, user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity interfaces for web and mobile products. I focus on the decisions that make a product easier to understand and cheaper to build.
items.bestFor: New products, redesigns, and features that need a clearer interaction model.

items.title: Web design & front-end
items.short: Editorial websites that look considered and load quickly.
items.description: Responsive marketing sites and content platforms designed in the browser. I write semantic HTML, maintainable CSS, and just enough JavaScript to make the experience feel alive.
items.bestFor: Portfolios, studio sites, publications, and product marketing pages.

items.title: Brand identity
items.short: A visual system with enough flexibility to grow with you.
items.description: Identity work for small businesses and independent studios: a clear strategic idea, a distinctive visual language, and practical guidelines for using it across print and digital.
items.bestFor: New studios, independent businesses, and products finding their voice.

items.title: Design systems
items.short: Shared foundations that help teams ship consistent work.
items.description: Token architecture, component libraries, and documentation built around the way a team actually works. The goal is not a perfect system; it is a system people can use and maintain.
items.bestFor: Growing product teams, multi-brand systems, and design debt clean-up.

items.title: Audits & consulting
items.short: A second set of eyes before the next big build.
items.description: Focused reviews of an existing site or product, with practical recommendations ranked by impact. Useful before a redesign, a migration, or a new hire starts.
items.bestFor: Teams that need clarity before investing in a larger project.

process.title: Discover
process.description: We start with the problem, the audience, and the constraints. I ask enough questions to avoid designing the wrong thing beautifully.

process.title: Define
process.description: Research becomes a clear brief, a content model, and a set of priorities. We agree on what success looks like before visual work begins.

process.title: Design
process.description: I work from structure to surface: flows, wireframes, then high-fidelity interfaces. Feedback happens in short, focused rounds.

process.title: Build
process.description: Design and implementation move together. I build responsive, accessible front ends or work closely with your engineering team.

process.title: Test & launch
process.description: We check the details that matter: keyboard access, performance, edge cases, and real content. Then we ship and document what comes next.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Most focused projects run between four and twelve weeks. A single-page site is usually faster than a multi-flow product. After a short discovery call I can give you a realistic scope and timeline rather than a guess.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams?
faqs.answer: Yes. I can join a product team for a defined piece of work, collaborate with in-house designers, or hand off a system to engineers. Clear communication and documented decisions are part of the engagement.

faqs.question: What does a project cost?
faqs.answer: Every engagement is scoped around the work, not a generic package. After we agree on the outcomes, I provide a fixed project fee or a monthly retainer. I do not publish prices because a useful estimate depends on scope.

faqs.question: Can you build what you design?
faqs.answer: For websites and front-end work, yes. I build semantic, responsive interfaces and can work within your stack. For complex back-end or native mobile work, I collaborate with your engineers or a trusted development partner.

faqs.question: What happens after launch?
faqs.answer: You receive the source files, documentation, and a short handoff session. I also offer a limited post-launch support window for fixes and small refinements. Ongoing retainers are available for teams that need regular design support.
